note: Female pirate with a pistol, three-quarter view (left/right are image sides). Hat and the long dark hair, including the lock hanging down the right side to y~508, and the face are head: chin y~400, left lock to y~440; the pink neck below the chin, coat collar, coat, belt with buckle and the short coat skirts (flap on the right to y~806) are torso. Right arm (image right): the rounded grey-green sleeve y~440-543 is the upper arm, elbow at the change to the purple cuff y~543; the cuff and the white frill beside the hand are forearm to y~580; pale fist y580-642 is hand. Left arm (image left) is foreshortened and the art marks little: the sleeve edge y436-526 is the upper arm, the purple cuff y526-548 the forearm, and the pale fist y548-616 (thumb/palm x358-418) plus the fingers wrapping the pistol grip (x298-336, y540-594) are hand. The pistol (barrel tip at x~215,y~388, grip down to y~624) is equipment, kept off the fingers and palm; the arm reading is uncertain. Hem: the left skirt edge y~745 and right y~757 are the hips; bare thighs show below (left y745-772, right y757-783); boot tops (y772 left, y783 right) are above halfway hip to ankle so they are the knees; ankles y~865 (left, where the toe flares) and y~880 (right, at the ankle strap).
